meta.escopo: Company tag, the v1 subset: registration, certificate and NFS-e configuration. The per-service configuration of the other eight fiscal documents is out of v1.
meta.objetivo: Single source of the Portuguese-to-English mapping for the Company operations. Same conventions as de-para/nfse-dps.json.
meta.estadoDeConfianca: PARTIAL. The fields below come from two sources of evidence only: the POST /empresas example in the documentation and the console's NFS-e configuration screen. The JSON names of the tax regime fields have NOT been seen in a real payload and are marked with nomeJsonPendente. Complete them from the swagger before generating properties for this part.
meta.avisoSeguranca: The certificate operation receives the A1 file in Base64 plus its password. n8n persists execution data in its database, so those values can remain in the history. The password is typed as 'password', the node never echoes this payload in an error, and the README recommends the console as the default path.

inscricao_municipal.name: municipalTaxRegistration
inscricao_municipal.description: Municipal tax registration number (inscricao_municipal). Required by many cities for NFS-e.

endereco.name: address
endereco.camposPendentes: The documentation example shows only 'logradouro' and 'numero' before truncating. Missing: district, municipality and IBGE code, state, postal code, complement. The node's own Postal Code lookup fills in most of it.

certificado.name: certificate
certificado.description: A1 digital certificate encoded in Base64 (certificado). Prefer uploading it through the ACBr API console — this operation exists for automated onboarding at scale.
certificado.nota: Never echo this value in an error message. Consider accepting binary data from the workflow and converting it, instead of a string.

password.name: certificatePassword
password.nota: Typed as password so n8n masks it in the UI. That does not prevent it from being persisted in execution data.

configuracaoNfse.nota: Fields derived from the console screen and from the documentation example. The values here are INJECTED by the API into the DPS — confirmed by 'opSimpNac' and 'regEspTrib' appearing in the transmitted XML and absent from the JSON that was sent.

rps.lote.name: nextBatchNumber
rps.lote.description: Next RPS batch number to be used (rps.lote).

rps.numero.name: nextInvoiceNumber
rps.numero.description: Next RPS number to be used (rps.numero).

situacaoSimplesNacional.name: simplesNacionalStatus
situacaoSimplesNacional.description: Whether the company is enrolled in the Simples Nacional tax regime.
situacaoSimplesNacional.nomeJsonPendente: Label seen on the console screen; the JSON name is not confirmed. Likely match in the DPS: prest.regTrib.opSimpNac.

regimeEspecialTributacao.name: specialTaxRegime
regimeEspecialTributacao.description: Special municipal tax regime applied to the company.
regimeEspecialTributacao.nomeJsonPendente: Likely match in the DPS: prest.regTrib.regEspTrib.

regimeApuracaoSimplesNacional.name: simplesNacionalAssessmentRegime
regimeApuracaoSimplesNacional.description: Assessment regime for companies under Simples Nacional (ME/EPP).

incentivoFiscal.name: hasTaxIncentive
incentivoFiscal.description: Whether the company holds a municipal tax incentive.

prefeitura.login.name: cityHallLogin
prefeitura.login.description: Login required by some city halls for direct communication.
prefeitura.login.nota: If the municipality requires it and it is not configured, issuing fails.

prefeitura.senha.name: cityHallPassword
prefeitura.senha.description: Password required by some city halls for direct communication.

prefeitura.token.name: cityHallToken
prefeitura.token.description: Token required by some city halls for direct communication.

pendentes.nota: Company operations in v1 whose payloads have not been mapped yet.
itens: PUT /empresas/{cpf_cnpj}/certificado/upload — multipart, decide whether the node accepts binary data from the workflow
PUT/GET/DELETE /empresas/{cpf_cnpj}/logotipo — formato e limites de imagem
